skillAnalysis.summary: 确认包含 10 个有效 DSH Skills。

targets.name: yao-agent
targets.description: Agent management expert. ALWAYS invoke this skill when you need to list available agents, download or reference agent source code, deploy agent code to the host, or query the LLM connector matrix. Do not guess agent structures — use this skill first.

targets.name: yao-audio
targets.description: Audio expert. ALWAYS invoke this skill when the user asks to transcribe, recognize, or convert speech/audio to text.

targets.name: yao-board
targets.description: Kanban board and task query expert. ALWAYS invoke this skill when the user asks about boards, tasks, task status, or project progress. Do not guess task state — use this skill first.

targets.name: yao-doc
targets.description: Yao process documentation expert. ALWAYS invoke this skill when the user needs to discover available processes, read process signatures, or validate process names. Do not guess process APIs — use this skill first.

targets.name: yao-image
targets.description: Image expert. ALWAYS invoke this skill when you need to read, analyze, describe, or generate images. Use for screenshots, photos, charts, diagrams, AI-generated images, or any visual content.

targets.name: yao-process
targets.description: Yao process execution expert. ALWAYS invoke this skill when the user needs to call a Yao process, query data models, run scripts, or check process permissions. Do not call processes without checking this skill first.

targets.name: yao-secret
targets.description: Secret management expert. ALWAYS invoke this skill when you need to read API keys, tokens, or other secrets configured by the user. Never hardcode credentials — use this skill to retrieve them securely.

targets.name: yao-web
targets.description: Web information retrieval expert. ALWAYS invoke this skill when the user needs to search the web, fetch a URL, or access real-time information beyond training data. Do not guess or use stale knowledge — use this skill first.

targets.name: yao-workspace
targets.description: Workspace file I/O expert. ALWAYS invoke this skill when you need to list workspaces, read or write files in a workspace on a remote node, or browse workspace directories. Use this for cross-node file operations — for local sandbox files, use standard filesystem tools instead.

targets.name: yao-workspace-config
targets.description: Workspace Git identity and credential management. ALWAYS invoke this skill when the user asks about configuring Git user info, adding HTTPS tokens, importing SSH keys, or managing workspace-level Git authentication.
